result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered. The one clear visual defect is the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now', which shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo. Other elements (carousels, category chips, promo banner, bottom nav) appear intact.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a generic broken-image icon on a gray background instead of the restaurant's hero photo, while neighboring cards render images correctly.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image URL/asset for this restaurant and fix the failed load; provide a branded fallback image or skeleton so a broken-image icon is never shown to users.
